observation.command: cd /workspace && echo '--- HTTP via traefik ---' && curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'code=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n' http://127.0.0.1/ -H 'Host: localhost' && echo '--- HTTPS via traefik (no cert expected) ---' && curl -sk -o /dev/null -w 'code=%{http_code}\n' https://127.0.0.1/ --max-time 8; echo "exit=$?"
